notes: Use manufacturer specification or calibration evidence; display resolution is not accuracy
Estimate only from genuine repeated measurements using the reviewed method
Record measured evidence or a justified estimate; do not infer from appearance
Include spatial variation and the method used to assess parallelism
Consider deformation under mounting and caliper contact force
Account for cosine and contact-geometry effects relative to the plane normal
Record temperature and relevant environmental conditions at measurement time
Treat separately from accuracy and calibration uncertainty
Record method and any supported estimate
